unknown_policy.policy: Hidden or unresolved cuff is UNKNOWN; confirmed absence of sleeve or differentiated cuff is NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence. Optional missing slot imposes no new legacy context requirement.

labels.notes: Attribute contract approved by decision 10; values and annotation guidance pending. No cuff specialist training is authorized.

taxonomy_labels.multi_piece: Entity-level coordinated_set plus separately labeled components; not a single image pseudo-garment

target_policy.known: Value loss computed only with evidence and adjudicated label.
target_policy.unknown: Mask loss and report coverage; never convert to negative.
target_policy.not_applicable: Mask value loss, validate applicability; separate routing if justified later.
target_policy.multi_label_negatives: Only explicitly adjudicated absent labels are negatives; incomplete sets have separate annotation completeness.
target_policy.public_labels: Map with direction and loss; never treat missing source annotations as MORE negatives.

multi_label: mAP where ranked complete GT exists

evaluation_policy: Global AND per-family/per-attribute metrics; unknown/N/A/support denominators explicit; no arbitrary promotion numbers.
head_policy: Semantic scopes only. No encoder, multi-head, specialist network or MoE architecture selected.

metadata.commercial_mapping_policy: Commercial mappings are lookup candidates or scope policies, never automatic ground truth for training.
metadata.sleeve_cuff_training_policy: No dedicated cuff specialist selected or authorized; future_head=null and trainable_visual=no in this draft.
